name: Dr. Sage
role: Paw & Sage on-camera AI avatar for cat behavior and care explainers

visual_identity.face: oval, harmonious proportions, softly defined jawline, gently rounded chin, medium-height even forehead, relatively high but subtle cheekbones, warm approachable expression
visual_identity.eyes: hazel-green, direct but gentle eye contact
visual_identity.hair: medium to chestnut brown, warm copper and golden light reflections, natural voluminous waves, slightly past shoulder length, light side part from viewer-left, hair falling naturally around the face
visual_identity.wardrobe: sage-green linen blouse (#4D7C5A) under an unbuttoned cream cardigan (#FBF8F3)
visual_identity.jewelry: fine gold necklace with a small paw pendant centered on the neckline
visual_identity.mouth_and_lips: friendly relaxed smile, medium balanced lip fullness, natural soft pink/nude lip color, not red lipstick; for avatar source images prefer closed lips or barely parted lips without visible teeth
visual_identity.skin: light to medium warm peach undertone, smooth natural texture, fine pores, natural glow, soft warm cheek redness, gentle cheekbone shadows

brand_world.lighting: warm side light from viewer-left, highlights on the left side of face and hair, soft shadows on viewer-right
brand_world.mood: warm, trustworthy, calmly competent, editorial documentary

elevenlabs.export_format: WAV 44.1 kHz preferred; MP3 192 kbps acceptable

video_generation.image_requirements: front-facing Dr. Sage still, neutral closed mouth, PNG, >=720x900, <=10MB
video_generation.motion_style: calm eye contact, natural blinks, subtle head movement, no large gestures
